query: Male patient, 94. Among male ICU patients aged 89–99, what is the 95th‑percentile 48‑hour instability score for ischemic stroke? For the top instability quartile, compare ischemic stroke versus general ICU: N, mean instability, mean abnormal episodes, mean ICU LOS (hrs), and mortality.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) within GROUP (ORDER BY instability_score) AS top_quartile_instability_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ischemic_stroke_patients) AS ischemic_stroke_patients_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM male_icu_patients) AS male_icu_patients_count, (SELECT AVG(length_of_stay) FROM instability_scores) AS average_length_of_stay, (SELECT AVG(instability_score) FROM instability_scores) AS average_instability_score, (SELECT AVG(outtime - intime) FROM chartevents WHERE itemid = 1544655 AND valueuom = 'hr') AS average_los FROM instability_scores;
